_about: What the adlerOS helper (agent.py) may do when adlerOS asks.
Each action: a label shown while it runs, the parameters it accepts (each
checked against its pattern, anything else rejected), and steps run in order:
{"run": [argv...]}         a command, no shell. {adleros} is this repo's
{param:NAME} a whole argument from the params
{"set-config": [KEYS...]}  write those params into the settings file
"result": true on a run step: its output is JSON handed to the page
"quiet": true on an action: a status check, run alongside anything else
"admin": true: only while admin mode is on (Settings); "core" for apps:
only when the app is a core one
"mode": "standalone" or "homelab": only in that kind of install
Root-only commands go through sudo to root-owned copies that install.sh puts
A homelab adds its own actions in its scripts/agent/actions.json.

app-status.label: Checking apps
app-status.description: Reports each app's containers for the App Store.

app-usage.label: Measuring apps
app-usage.description: Each app's CPU and memory right now (docker stats), for Live Usage.

app-logs.label: Reading logs
app-logs.description: The app's recent logs (docker compose logs), for its Logs view.

app-start.label: Starting
app-start.description: Starts every container of the app (each compose file in its folder).

app-stop.label: Stopping
app-stop.description: Stops every container of the app; they stay, ready to start again.

app-restart.label: Restarting
app-restart.description: Restarts every container of the app.

app-update.label: Updating
app-update.description: Pulls the app's newest images and recreates its containers on them (docker compose pull, then up -d). Data stays.

app-install.label: Installing
app-install.description: Puts an app (back) on the home screen: from the catalog or the store it's set up and started; an imported one starts again.

app-delete.label: Deleting
app-delete.description: Removes the app's containers and takes it off the home screen. Its data and compose files stay.

app-import-scan.label: Looking for compose files
app-import-scan.description: Lists the compose files in a folder of yours, with their services, for Import.

app-import.label: Importing
app-import.description: Adds an app from one of your compose files (containers/extras/<app>/app.json): its service first, then the services it needs. Nothing is moved.

app-forget.label: Removing from adlerOS
app-forget.description: Un-imports an imported app. Its containers and files aren't touched.

firefox-open.label: Opening in Firefox
firefox-open.description: Opens a PDF from Files in the Firefox app from the store: a copy goes into its own folder (config/adleros-open next to its compose file, cleared after a day) and Firefox opens it in a new tab, starting again if it had closed.

files-root.label: Changing Root
files-root.description: A change in Files' Root, the homelab's own folder (adlerOS sees it read-only). What to change is in data/agent/files/<request>.json; agent/files.py also refuses unless ADLEROS_TERMINAL=on on the machine.

app-discover.label: Looking for apps
app-discover.description: Scans your compose folders again: new compose files become apps, sorted into collections.

app-folders.label: Looking in your compose folders
app-folders.description: Sets where adlerOS looks for apps (COMPOSE_ROOTS: folders that exist, in your home folder or /opt, /srv, /mnt, /media, /data), then looks there.

update-adleros.label: Updating adlerOS
update-adleros.description: Gets the newest adlerOS (git pull), then restarts it.
